question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Hostile
solution: The correct answer is **"Hospitable."**** * **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hostile"** means unfriendly and aggressive. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति अत्‍यंत उग्र भावनाओं वाला; प्रतिकूल भाव) • Example**: That was a **hostile**__ crowd.* • **"Hospitable"** is the opposite of **"Hostile."** • **"Hospitable"** means friendly and welcoming. ((व्‍यक्ति) मेहमानों के प्रति मित्रवत और उदार; आतिथ्‍यकारी, सत्‍कारशील, मेहमाननवाज़) __ • **Example**: *The villagers were very **hospitable**__ to/towards anyone who passed through.* • The correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Bitter** means having a sharp and unpleasant taste. (क्रोध या घृणा से प्रेरित, कड़वाहट-भरा) • **Nasty** means unpleasant or unenjoyable. (बहुत बुरा या अप्रिय) • **Aggressive** means ready or likely to attack or confront. (लड़ाका, हमलावर, झगड़ालू, आक्रामक) 36:Ta3e, The correct answer is: **Are the Shuklas visited by the Basus? **
